scope: Tokyo-first release governance: the regional 48-target list is retained as legacy reference data, while release coverage is governed by the audited Tokyo coverage universe.

coverageUniverse.denominatorPolicy: Do not use the existing curated target count or regional fixed target counts as the Tokyo coverage denominator.

releaseGate.metricSeparation: Research completeness, user-visible production coverage, and schema-addressable coverage are independent release metrics. Formal disposition is not production availability.

addressableProductionConversion.rule: Every current-schema or approved-schema-extension addressable MUST/SHOULD candidate must be production before release.

currentEvidenceBasedRawProductionFloor.dynamicRule: Each remaining unresearched SHOULD candidate later classified as schema-addressable increases the required numerator by one; it cannot replace an existing required venue.

releaseGate.exclusions: 候補はraw denominatorから削除しない。非production免責はB SOURCE-LIMITED、C CONTRADICTION、D CURRENTNESS/CLOSEDだけで、A SCHEMA-UNLOCKABLEは免責しない。
releaseGate.configurationSupport: issuer-defined complete configurations and independently defined fixed-only subsets must be supported before the A cohort can count as covered.
releaseGate.holds: HOLD/CONTRADICTIONはA/B/C/D blocker taxonomy、issuer-owned official blocker、currentness、schema addressabilityを明示記録する
releaseGate.gapRule: 明らかな主要会場の候補漏れがないことを確認し、会場数だけで判定しない
releaseGate.productionQualityGate: 従来どおり変更しない（expectedSeatCount == calculatedSeatCount、独立公式第2パス差分ゼロ、verification.status=verified、unresolvedIssues=[]）
releaseGate.releaseCoverageAdequacyReview: After all mechanical gates pass, require one TOKYO RELEASE COVERAGE ADEQUACY REVIEW covering actual user-visible production coverage, B/C/D exclusions, and completed SHOULD research. Pending review always keeps RELEASE READY at NO.
releaseGate.readiness: Derived by venues:release:coverage from repository state. NO until research completeness, addressable production conversion, dynamic raw floors, configuration/fixed-only support, universe-gap, unchanged production quality, and release coverage adequacy review all pass. Legacy regional shortfalls are informational only.

legacyTargetPolicy: The existing targets remain traceable historical/preflight work items. They are not, by themselves, proof of Tokyo coverage or a release denominator.
